desk.summary: Sunday-morning final pass on the twelve Sunday games still to kick off plus Monday night, after Saturday's roster moves and the morning's feed: Lamar Jackson, Baker Mayfield and Jalen Hurts out (Huntley, Daniels, McKee start), Caleb Williams and A.J. Brown expected to play, Tyler Warren a game-time call. instructions: Study every angle before choosing: defensive matchups, weather, injuries, confirmed starters, man-to-man matchups, stats, tendencies and defensive weak points, and any other variable the evidence calls for.
Do not let the odds determine or influence a selection: choose on evidence, then show the DraftKings price and what it implies.
